intro: Zalashji's Den is a secluded cave tucked along the eastern coast of Tanaris. It serves as the solitary lair of Zalashji, an enigmatic naga who dwells far from the typical gathering grounds of his serpentine kin.

p: Carved into the rugged bluffs along the eastern shoreline of Tanaris, this coastal cavern provides shelter to a single inhabitant: Zalashji. Naga are known across Kalimdor to gather in disciplined war parties or coastal outposts, yet Zalashji resides here entirely alone. Little is known about why he made this isolated cave his domain, far removed from the primary settlements and desert ruins of the region, but any traveler venturing along the surf should approach the cave mouth with caution.
